item.title: WATCH AGAIN: MARTIN’S ACTION REPLAY
item.description: IT WAS deja vu all over again at Parkhead yesterday as Martin O’Neill staged his second comeback of Celtic inside three dramatic months. The 73-year-old Irishman answered the first SOS in late October following the rapid exit of Brendan Rodgers. O’Neill took over in an interim capacity as the champions searched for a long-term manager. [...]

item.title: O’NEILL ‘HOPEFUL’ OF NEW FACES
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL insists Celtic have no time to waste in bringing in recruitments in the January transfer window.
